summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Vox Royalty Corp., a foreign private issuer, containing a notice of annual and special meeting of shareholders and an information circular. The meeting, scheduled for May 27, 2026, covers routine items: receiving audited financial statements, electing directors, appointing an auditor, and approving a 2026 Omnibus Long Term Incentive Plan. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or management change. No deal terms are provided. The filing is a routine current report with no special situation.
